title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Trip Charge: Amount and Missed-Visit Credit
content:
**Clause.** The standard trip charge of a Warranty Coverage technician visit is the warranty plan's no-defect trip charge when the technician found no covered defect, and the warranty plan's out-of-term trip charge for any other visit priced, charged once for the visit. When the visit rebooks a missed visit on the same claim dated no more than the rebooking credit window of **30 days** earlier, the no-show fee booked on that missed visit is credited against the trip charge, which never goes below zero; a no-show fee on an earlier missed visit, or on another claim, is not credited.

**Order of working.** The trip rate is multiplied by the crew rate and then by the day rate; the access surcharge and the handling surcharge are added to that product; the program discount is taken off that sum; the missed-visit credit is deducted from what remains, never below zero; and the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, an amount exactly halfway between two cents going to the higher cent. The trip rate is the standard trip charge; the crew rate and the day rate are one; the access surcharge, the handling surcharge and the program discount are zero.

The no-defect and out-of-term trip charges are the figures of the plan's field service rate card. The visit priced is the latest technician visit recorded on the claim, with its date and its outcome.

## The credit in detail

| The visit rebooks | Missed visit dated | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| the latest missed visit on the same claim | 1 to 30 days before the visit | the no-show fee booked on that missed visit |
| the latest missed visit on the same claim | more than 30 days before the visit | none |
| — | an earlier missed visit on the claim, or one on another claim | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: standard trip charge 100.00)

1. No missed visit before it: 100.00 multiplied by one and by one, nothing added, nothing taken off, gives 100.00.
2. A missed visit on the same claim 12 days earlier with a booked no-show fee of 80.00: 100.00 less 80.00 is 20.00.
3. The same missed visit 31 days earlier: no credit, 100.00.
4. A missed visit 5 days earlier with a booked no-show fee of 120.00: 100.00 less 120.00 would go below zero, so the trip charge is 0.00.
5. A missed visit 5 days earlier on which no no-show fee is booked: nothing is credited, 100.00.
